svg.title: Elixir AI Engineer — System Architecture
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: Spec Layer at top, Harness Pipeline in the middle, Substrate at bottom, with feedback loops connecting runtime back to spec.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What goes in the Charter spec layer?')
sendPrompt('What is the Domain Model in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('What is the Boundary Graph spec artifact?')
sendPrompt('What are Contracts in the spec layer?')
sendPrompt('What are SpecCells and how do they compose?')
sendPrompt('What do State machines specify?')
sendPrompt('What do Effect declarations specify?')
sendPrompt('What does the OTP topology specify?')
sendPrompt('What is ENF policy?')
sendPrompt('What test obligations does the spec declare?')
sendPrompt('How does the Context Bundle Compiler work?')
g.text: resolves SpecCell → typed packet for one agent task

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the Architecture Tournament and when does it run?')
sendPrompt('What does the Skeleton Generator produce?')
sendPrompt('What is an ADR in this system?')
sendPrompt('What is Bounded LM Fill and what can the LM change?')
g.text: fills holes only — may not invent modules/effects/processes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Implementation Graph Extractor produce?')
g.text: AST → modules, calls, effects, processes, boundaries

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What tests does the Evidence Runner run?')
sendPrompt('What does the ENF Auditor check?')
g.text: module kind · process justification · API trace · effect decl.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Compression Normalizer work?')
g.text: challenges cost · proposes lower-mechanism rewrite · re-runs evidence

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does it mean for code to be accepted by the harness?')
g.text: spec · evidence · ENF · cost — all must pass

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does accepted code contain in the lineage record?')
g.text: spec cell · bundle hash · operator runs · normalization report

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the SpecGraph?')
sendPrompt('What is the ImplementationGraph?')
sendPrompt('What is the EvidenceGraph?')
sendPrompt('What is the RuntimeGraph?')
sendPrompt('What is the LineageGraph?')
sendPrompt('What does mix spec.audit check?')
sendPrompt('What does mix spec.bundle produce?')
sendPrompt('What does mix spec.accept gate on?')
sendPrompt('What does mix spec.compress do?')
sendPrompt('How does runtime evidence feed back into the spec?')
g.text: BEAM telemetry · fault injection · adversarial tests → spec refinement candidates
